leadText:
(Japanese: テンイむら Ten'i Village) is an -exclusive location in the Sinnoh region. It was featured in Giratina and the Sky Warrior. The village lies beside a lake, near the base of a glacier. The temple of the is also located nearby.

During the events of the movie, the glacier became unstable after Zero smashed the ice pillars in the Reverse World. As a result, the glacier began to slide down towards the village. called out her and to use their attacks to prevent the glacier from sliding any further. With the help of the local Pokémon, they managed to freeze the lake, but it wasn't enough to stop the glacier from moving. Eventually, Regigigas and several were able to stop the glacier and thus the village was saved from the impending disaster.

The village made a brief appearance in Arceus and the Jewel of Life, in which it was revealed that Sheena and went there to investigate the recent catastrophe after observing disruptions in the Time-Space Axis.
